final_annotation_source: gold-set-round1-2026-10-28.json plus the explicit overrides in this file
scope: 55 synthetic rewrites derived from observed Gmail, Ed, and Moodle triage patterns; no raw private content is stored

agreement.narrative_fields: not compared by exact string; adjudicate for entailment and evidence support

resolution_rules: Optional attendance or survey participation is not action_required=yes unless the source makes it mandatory.
A formal deadline, eligibility condition, security alert, or changed submission requirement is critical when missing it can materially affect assessment, access, or account safety.
An unanswered student question remains uncertain; a peer suggestion cannot become an official requirement.
A duplicate reminder is kept in the source set but receives the same duplicate_group and may be collapsed in the product view.
Narrative summaries and evidence quotes are judged for supported meaning, not string identity.

notable_adjudications.reason: Q&A attendance is explicitly optional; the event is useful but not required.
The outage can affect a student's immediate study workflow even though it is not course-specific.
Duplicate receipt with no new outcome or deadline.
A payment deadline matters, but the sample does not state loss of enrolment or another critical consequence.
Private appointment logistics are outside the academic triage scope in this sample.
The message announces an existing test arrangement; it does not itself state that a previously known requirement changed.
The staff answer says the hurdle is an independent pass condition, so missing it can directly affect passing the unit.
The student needs a staff-confirmed alternative; the post does not establish that downloading a copy is allowed.
